questions.ideal_answer: Box<T> and Rc<T> differ in several ways: Box<T> is heap allocation (works by single ownership heap pointer) whereas Rc<T> is reference counting (works by multiple ownership single-threaded). Box<T> is typically used for automatic deallocation, while Rc<T> is used for non-atomic counters. Example demonstrating Box<T>: let b = Box::new(5);. Example demonstrating Rc<T>: let data = Rc::new(vec![1, 2, 3]);.
